title: SUITES_I parsing: test expectations contradict RFC 9528 Section 3.3.2
description:
## Root Cause
Multiple tests have incorrect expectations that contradict RFC 9528 Section 3.3.2, which specifies that the FIRST element of a SUITES_I array is the selected suite. The tests expect the LAST element to be selected.

## Affected Tests

### 1. rfc9528_suites_i_literals (line 662)
- Test expects `Ok((0, 3))` (suite 0, the LAST element of array [2, 0])
- Implementation correctly returns `Ok((2, 3))` (suite 2, the FIRST element)
- Another test at line 997 correctly expects `(2, 3)` for identical input

**Fix:** Change line 662 from `assert_eq!(parse_suites_i(&[0x82, 0x02, 0x00, 0xff]), Ok((0, 3)));` to `assert_eq!(parse_suites_i(&[0x82, 0x02, 0x00, 0xff]), Ok((2, 3)));`

### 2. suites_i_parses_every_signed_integer_width (line 695)
- CBOR `[0x8b, 0x17, ...]` decodes to 11-element array where FIRST element is 23
- Test expects `Ok((0, 42))` but parser correctly returns `Ok((23, 42))`

**Fix:** Change line 695 from `assert_eq!(parse_suites_i(&suites), Ok((0, suites.len() - 1)));` to `assert_eq!(parse_suites_i(&suites), Ok((23, suites.len() - 1)));`

### 3. responder_applies_suite_selection_rules (line 711)
- Test sends SUITES_I = [2, 0] expecting success when responder only supports suite 0
- Per RFC 9528, first element (2) is selected suite, so responder correctly rejects
- Another test (test_responder_rejects_unsupported_suite_in_array at line 1040) correctly expects rejection for same input

**Fix:** Delete or rewrite this test - its expectations are backwards per RFC 9528.

## Location
/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/tests.rs

## Error Type
Incorrect test expectations - implementation is correct per RFC 9528
